reviewerType: Independent AI agent; not an external human study.
methodLimits: Reviewer viewed seven ordered A/B pairs without the pair mapping, QA, source or parameter values in this review.
The same reviewer had seen earlier local experimental variants. This is order/label blindness, not a new naive reviewer or a double-blind human study.
Only static images were supplied. No temporal stability verdict follows.
